tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Headings, body text, primary buttons, arrow squares, the announcement bar, footer and B2B band (17.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The page ground everywhere, and the background behind every product photo. Text on black.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white: the collection letters (א׳ ב׳), captions, prices' context (5.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px beige hairlines: under the header, between sections and collection rows, product and image frames (black on hover). Decoration only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The accent, in small touches: the dot after a heading and after the logo, the 4px bar before an eyebrow, 2px link underlines, the ✱ in the marquee. As text only on black (5.7:1): announcement bar, 'New' tag, footer column heads. As a fill only for the one CTA on black (B2B quote, club signup), with black text. Never text on white (3.1:1).

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Old name kept for Elementor (kl-gold-deep). Same as gold.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Headings and chip outlines on black (the B2B band). Never on white.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Sale tag and alerts only, occasionally. White text on red.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Rare: placeholder fill. Never behind products and never as a section ground.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of a collection row. Nothing else.

tokens.name: on-black-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on black: the footer's bottom line (9:1 on black).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Heebo only. Main headings are all 900, with no thin/bold mix; categories are 500.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero headline and the statement band. 68px on phones. A gold dot may end it.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings (new on the shelf, custom design, B2B, the store). 36–44px on phones.

styles.name: category
styles.usage: Collection and category names in the lettered rows. 34px on phones.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The paragraph under the hero headline.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Secondary headings: the custom-design picker steps, footer column heads.

styles.name: product-name
styles.usage: Product name and price on one line under the photo.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions and the footer's bottom line.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels after a 32×4 gold bar. The marquee uses the same look at 16px, 0.2em.

styles.name: sticker
styles.usage: The round black sticker on the hero photo, white text, turned -10°. 15px on phones.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: KETERLION. On the site it is an image, not live text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Ring gap around the selected color swatch.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inline buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; between product cards on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between product cards on desktop; collection row inner gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Side gutter on desktop; heading to grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, product frames, tags, bars and sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: A slight round on everything you press or type in: buttons, header buttons, inputs, the signup field, chips, arrow squares.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only color swatch dots, the dot after headings and the round sticker.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Beige (line) dividers and frames everywhere; the black outline of secondary buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The gold underline under text links. No black 2px rules any more.

tokens.name: accent-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the 32px gold bar before an eyebrow (8px for the 88px bar above the statement).
